note: Every rule is a candidate until calibrate.mjs and the owner set its tier (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.2).

rules.title: Purple-to-blue gradient
rules.scope: Visible gradient stops sweeping purple/violet/indigo (hue 250-300, saturation > 0.25) into blue/cyan; weighted on filled CTAs and heroes
rules.falsePositives: Sponsor or brand gradients inside hash-matched official files; data-viz ramps
rules.fix: Solid fills from the token plan; one accent

rules.title: Gradient hero text
rules.scope: background-clip:text with a gradient background-image, strongest on h1/h2 >= 32px
rules.falsePositives: A wordmark set as text; one documented display treatment in a real design system
rules.fix: Solid colour; hierarchy through size and weight

rules.title: Emojis in headings
rules.scope: Extended_Pictographic characters in h1-h6, [role=heading], or emoji-prefixed nav items
rules.falsePositives: Emoji or chat products; quoted or user-generated content; flags in a country picker
rules.fix: Remove; icons only where they carry meaning

rules.title: Inter everywhere
rules.scope: Inter as the only rendered family (CDP rendered fonts), especially with a centred hero
rules.falsePositives: A deliberate UI type system; sponsor brand font; human controls use Inter (advisory until calibrated)
rules.fix: A display face from brand research, with a recorded reason

rules.title: Colored border cards
rules.scope: Left or top accent stripe >= 2px, > 1px wider than other sides, saturated, containing a heading. Static layer also: (b) all-side card borders tinted with a hue at rest, at any alpha, reported when 2+ cards carry one (status tokens such as warning, error or success and hairlines under OKLCH chroma 0.06 excluded); (c) gradient borders (a saturated gradient behind a 1-2px padded rounded wrapper, border-image, or a border-box gradient behind a transparent border)
rules.falsePositives: Callouts, active tabs, timelines, severity in dashboards; status colours, selected and focus states, one highlighted card, a grey gradient border
rules.fix: Remove the stripe; if it encodes status, add a label

rules.title: Glassmorphism cards
rules.scope: Card-sized elements with backdrop blur >= 2px and translucent background (skip sticky full-width bars)
rules.falsePositives: Frosted navigation bars; overlays on media
rules.fix: Opaque surfaces; glass only where layering is real

rules.title: Low-contrast dark mode
rules.scope: Dark body (luminance < 0.2) with >= 12% of body text below 7:1
rules.falsePositives: Dark-first trading or IDE products with sparing secondary text
rules.fix: Lighter text steps on dark grounds; fewer grey levels

rules.title: Three icon boxes in a row
rules.scope: 3 or 6 equal-width siblings each with an 8-48px svg in a filled 20-72px wrapper above a heading
rules.falsePositives: Very common on human sites; real triplets; pricing
rules.fix: Structure from content: one dominant feature with a real demo

rules.title: Badge above the headline
rules.scope: A pill, boxed or small-caps element within 220px above the h1
rules.falsePositives: A real, checkable status linked to proof (testnet contract, changelog); breadcrumbs
rules.fix: Delete, fold into the headline, or link it to proof

rules.title: Lucide icons everywhere
rules.scope: lucide-react dependency and imports; rendered svg.lucide count; decorative icons per heading
rules.falsePositives: A consciously chosen set used on actions
rules.fix: Fewer icons, on actions; custom glyphs for protocol concepts

rules.title: Untouched shadcn UI
rules.scope: shadcn default tokens (radius 0.625rem, primary oklch(0.205 0 0), dark background oklch(0.145 0 0)), registry-identical components, hover alpha 0.8/0.9
rules.falsePositives: shadcn with customised tokens; internal tools
rules.fix: Tokens from brand research first; then components

rules.title: Fade-in on scroll
rules.scope: Text hidden at rest (opacity < 0.1) that appears after scrolling; IntersectionObserver or whileInView reveals
rules.falsePositives: One orchestrated load moment; a scroll-driven diagram that explains the mechanism
rules.fix: Content visible by default; motion only where it explains

rules.title: Cursor-following beam
rules.scope: mousemove/pointermove listeners that change background, transform or custom properties along a synthetic mouse path
rules.falsePositives: Charts with crosshairs, maps, games, 3D viewers
rules.fix: Remove, or make hover reveal real protocol data

rules.title: Buttons fade on hover
rules.scope: CTA hover changes only opacity or background alpha
rules.falsePositives: Ghost buttons; a design system that specifies it
rules.fix: A state change with intent: darken by token, press scale

rules.title: Inconsistent spacing
rules.scope: Distinct section paddings, off-scale margins and gaps (calibrated; AI pages can be more regular, FD17-F21)
rules.falsePositives: clamp() fluid spacing; optical tweaks; embeds
rules.fix: Spacing and section-rhythm tokens

rules.title: Em dashes everywhere
rules.scope: U+2014 per 1,000 words of rendered innerText above the /prose PR-01 rate, minimum word count; 'WORD — fragment' labels
rules.falsePositives: Quoted text; proper names; non-English copy
rules.fix: Rewrite the copy; run /prose on the exported UI copy

rules.title: Generic buzzword copy
rules.scope: Promotional and LLM-register phrases in the UI copy whose sentence names no number or sponsor (static: a claim-like number, an amount, percentage, multiplier or count with a unit, never digits inside a name such as 0G or ERC-7857 or a bare year; runtime: any digit in the block), plus stock template phrases above 2.0 per 1,000 words of copy (static, 3+ hits in 300+ words); <design>/glossary.json removes per project the protocol words it lists (decentralized, decentralised, autonomous, ecosystem) from the stock list
rules.falsePositives: Quoting a sponsor tagline
rules.fix: Specific verbs and nouns

rules.title: Serif italic accents
rules.scope: The largest heading (>= 32px) mixes two families, roman and italic, or two paints; display text only
rules.falsePositives: Editorial or literary brands; prose emphasis (Emil Kowalski's blog sets prose em in serif italic)
rules.fix: One family with weight contrast, or no accent

rules.title: Space Grotesk + Instrument Serif
rules.scope: Rendered heading font, or >= 25% of text, in the dated reflex list (Space Grotesk, Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Bricolage Grotesque, Syne, Sora, Young Serif)
rules.falsePositives: Brand-mandated fonts with a recorded reason
rules.fix: Choose from brand research and record why

rules.title: Grain over a gradient
rules.scope: A full-size overlay (pointer-events none, opacity < 0.3) with a noise or feTurbulence image over a gradient
rules.falsePositives: Film, print or photographic brands
rules.fix: Flat surfaces or real imagery

rules.title: Cream + serif + clay ('tasteful default')
rules.scope: Warm light ground near #F4F1EA/#FAF9F5, serif display, clay accent near #D97757
rules.falsePositives: Editorial, food and craft brands
rules.fix: Palette from research

rules.title: ALL-CAPS tracked eyebrow above every heading
rules.scope: uppercase + letter-spacing >= 0.5px label directly above h2/h3, counted per section
rules.falsePositives: Krebs dropped all-caps headings for firing on clean sites
rules.fix: At most one eyebrow per three sections, or none

rules.title: Numbered 01/02/03 markers
rules.scope: Ascending numbered markers beside headings that are not a real sequence
rules.falsePositives: A real sequence (a process, a flow)
rules.fix: Numbers only where order is information

rules.title: Stat banner with invented numbers
rules.scope: 3-6 siblings with >= 22px numeric text (not prices or ordinals) without data-ledger/data-source
rules.falsePositives: Real, sourced metrics
rules.fix: Real, linked data or none

rules.title: Fake testimonials, avatars, 'Trusted by' walls
rules.scope: Testimonial arrays with names, randomuser/pravatar images, 'Trusted by' logo rows without links
rules.falsePositives: Real partners with permission
rules.fix: Omit; cite real relations only

rules.title: FAQ accordion with 3+ items
rules.scope: details/accordion block under a 'Frequently asked' heading
rules.falsePositives: Genuine support content
rules.fix: Answer inside the product narrative

rules.title: SaaS-card kit
rules.scope: Many sibling cards with identical radius and rgba(0,0,0,0.1) shadow
rules.falsePositives: Real design systems with one radius
rules.fix: Radius and shadow by hierarchy; fewer containers

rules.title: Near-black + zinc dark default
rules.scope: Neutral body background with luminance < 0.01 (#0a0a0a, oklch(0.145 0 0), zinc-950)
rules.falsePositives: Dark-first products
rules.fix: Ground and neutrals from brand research

rules.title: Coloured glows, halos, blurred blobs
rules.scope: >= 2 decorative elements with blur >= 15px and saturation > 0.3
rules.falsePositives: Brand light effects in media products
rules.fix: Neutral elevation; no decorative blobs

rules.title: Logo or text marquee
rules.scope: Continuous translateX animation on a repeated row
rules.falsePositives: Real partner lists
rules.fix: Static, linked list

rules.title: Bento grid
rules.scope: Grid with more than 4 cells of unequal spans
rules.falsePositives: Content with real hierarchy
rules.fix: Use only when the content has that shape

rules.title: Centred hero + 'Get started' + 'Learn more'
rules.scope: Centred h1 with the two-CTA pair
rules.falsePositives: Common human convention
rules.fix: The hero shows the protocol working

rules.title: Template chrome (arrow suffix, middle-dot meta, mono micro-labels)
rules.scope: '→' in button text; ' · ' joins; uppercase mono 10-11px labels
rules.falsePositives: Real metadata lines
rules.fix: Plain labels

rules.title: Grid-line background, pulsing dot, blinking cursor
rules.scope: Tiled 1px line gradients; pulse animations not bound to live data
rules.falsePositives: Blueprint products; real live indicators
rules.fix: Remove or bind to real state

rules.title: Nested cards
rules.scope: Bordered or filled container inside a container at 2+ levels
rules.falsePositives: Dashboards with real grouping
rules.fix: Flatten; use spacing

rules.title: Shape-assembled SVG illustrations, div-built fake screenshots
rules.scope: Hero-sized inline SVG with many primitives; div 'window' mockups
rules.falsePositives: Diagrams, icons, logos
rules.fix: Real screenshots, a live demo or a protocol diagram

rules.title: 'Built for X' / 'Trusted by' headline formulas
rules.scope: Phrase match on rendered headings
rules.falsePositives: A real audience statement
rules.fix: Say what the protocol does and for whom

rules.title: Pill buttons everywhere
rules.scope: Most buttons with border-radius >= height/2
rules.falsePositives: A brand that uses pills deliberately
rules.fix: Radius by role from tokens

rules.title: 100vh hero
rules.scope: First section height >= the viewport height (h-screen, min-h-screen, 100vh)
rules.falsePositives: Full-bleed product canvases
rules.fix: Hero sized to content; proof visible in the first viewport

rules.title: Everything centred
rules.scope: Share of centred text blocks across sections
rules.falsePositives: Short landing pages with one column
rules.fix: Alignment from the category's conventions

rules.title: Figma Make export signatures
rules.scope: String-pinned imports (pkg@x.y.z), ImageWithFallback, Attributions.md, the :where(:not(:has([class*=' text-'])...)) guard, Figma file name as <title>
rules.falsePositives: None in shipped code
rules.fix: Treat the export as a wireframe; replace the visual layer

rules.title: Starter-template leftovers
rules.scope: 'Create Next App' / 'Vite + React' titles, #aa3bff, Geist default import, default favicons by normalised hash; v0.app scaffolds (static): generator 'v0.app' metadata, an unused next/font binding (const _inter = Inter({subsets})), and 2+ of v0's placeholder and icon files in public/ (placeholder-logo.svg, placeholder-user.jpg, icon-light-32x32.png), matched by name
rules.falsePositives: None in shipped code; a single placeholder file is the project's own and is not reported
rules.fix: Replace with the project's own assets

rules.title: Prebuilt wallet-connect defaults
rules.scope: 'Awesome DApp', 'awesome-dapp-url.tld', 'Powered by Mesh SDK', alert( in connect flows, default kit themes
rules.falsePositives: A kit fully themed from tokens
rules.fix: Own connect dialog on the chain's hooks

rules.title: Effect-catalogue components
rules.scope: Imports or copies of React Bits, Magic UI, Aceternity components not bound to product state
rules.falsePositives: An effect that encodes real state (a 120 ms flash on a real value change)
rules.fix: Remove, or bind to real state

rules.title: Unsourced metric
rules.scope: Stat-styled numeric text (or data-metric) without data-ledger or data-source; numeric literals in hero copy; static: members of an array literal of the same file mapped into display-size elements (text-3xl and up, or 28px / 1.75rem and up), each reported at its literal. Numbers inside longer strings are left to the runtime layer
rules.falsePositives: Prices, dates, version numbers, ordinals
rules.fix: Render only numbers from the claims ledger or a labelled data source

rules.title: Placeholder names and copy
rules.scope: Acme, John Doe, Jane Doe, lorem ipsum, TODO, example.com, [YOUR ...] in rendered text
rules.falsePositives: Test fixtures not rendered
rules.fix: Real content from the brief, or a visible 'not yet verified' state

rules.title: transition: all on interactive elements
rules.scope: Computed transition-property 'all' on buttons and links
rules.falsePositives: Rare legitimate uses
rules.fix: Explicit properties

rules.title: ease-in on UI entrances
rules.scope: Entrance animations with ease-in timing
rules.falsePositives: Exits along the same path
rules.fix: ease-out tokens

rules.title: UI durations of 500 ms or more
rules.scope: Transitions and animations >= 500 ms on UI elements (not page-level or full-height sheets)
rules.falsePositives: Toasts ~400 ms; full-height sheets 500 ms
rules.fix: Role budgets: press <= 160, tooltip <= 200, dropdown <= 250, modal <= 300 ms

rules.title: Entrances from scale(0)
rules.scope: Keyframes or transitions starting at scale(0)
rules.falsePositives: None for UI
rules.fix: Start from scale(0.9) or more with opacity

rules.title: Motion without reduced-motion handling
rules.scope: Animations run unchanged under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
rules.falsePositives: Opacity or colour only
rules.fix: Gentler motion under reduce; content visible
